<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <datamodel><data id="n" expr="0"/></datamodel>
  <state id="a"><transition event="go" cond="n = = 1" target="b"/></state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: ecmascript syntax error in `cond`: unexpected `=` where an operand was expected
notes: a condition that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` and evaluates as false, so this condition can never hold
diagnostics.help: `= =` is not an operator; write `==` without the space to compare
